newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae seen around 5,250 escudos after spli.
newsitem.headline: Sonae seen around 5,250 escudos after spli.

text.p: Shares of Portuguese group Sonae Investimentos are expected to adjust to a range of 5,150 and 5,350 escudos after the company is restructured into two separate businesses, analysts said.

Under a previously announced restructuring, Sonae Investimentos, which is now the holding company, will control the group's retail and property interests, while Sonae Industria and Pargeste, the services group, will be incorporated into Inparsa.
Shareholders who hold two shares in Sonae Investimentos have the right to receive one share in Inparsa. Applications for the rights will take place from February 17 to March 3.
Today is the last day for trade in shares of Sonae Investimentos before the restructuring.

"Considering that Inparsa's capital is 19.5 billion escudos, the value of each share will be 1,200 escudos and if each right will be half of that, or 600 escudos, then Sonae Investimentos could adjust to 5,200 escudos," said one analyst.
Another analyst said that considering that Inparsa was worth 1,600 escudos per share, the share price of Sonae Investimentos should correct to 5,050 escudos.
A third analyst said: "I think the Sonae share price could correct by about 500 escudos to 5,350, after deducting half of the nominal value of the Inparsa shares."
Sonae Investimentos hit a high of 5,930 escudos, before easing to 5,880, up 90, in volume of 152,183 at 1512 GMT.
An analysis of Schroders Securities, quoted by Expresso newspaper, said the real value of Sonae Investimentos shares after the restructuring would be between 5,600 and 5,750 escudos.
Schroders valued Inparsa at 1,800 escudos per share, but gave a reference value of 1,264 after accounting for the "patchwork" nature of its business.
It estimated that Sonae's net asset value after the restructuring would be 5,600 escudos per share.
